subject: SIG change request — consolidate diffs & re-answer process
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmefinancials.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: security@acmefinancials.com
Date: 2026-11-25T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: SIG v4 delta & evidence request

Olga / Redwood security team,

We published SIG v4 internally last week and are starting a sweep of vendors to capture re-answers and a redlined diff for our audit. Attached is a CSV listing only the questions that changed compared to v3 (SIG-v4-question-delta.csv). For Redwood we need:
- A consolidated re-answer file (prefer CSV) mapping old question IDs to new IDs and your updated answers.
- A redlined view or short note for any answers that materially changed.
- Any evidence artifacts that support changes for data protection/retention (PDFs or links).

Can you confirm Redwood's preferred format and whether you can deliver a single consolidated file + evidence by end of day Friday (Nov 27)? If you need more time, let me know a ETA — we have a tight window for our readiness review.

Also note Q73 and Q112 in the delta are high-priority for our reviewers (data retention and third-party cache).

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Senior InfoSec Manager
Acme Financials

Attachments: SIG-v4-question-delta.csv
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmefinancials.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-25T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG v4 delta & evidence request

Hi Liam — thanks for the heads up and for the delta CSV. We'll take this on and propose a delivery plan. Summary / proposal below:

Plan:
- Deliverable: one consolidated CSV mapping old->new IDs + updated answers, plus a small PDF with redlines/highlights for the 10 highest-impact changes.
- Evidence: we will include supporting artifacts (redwood-sig-reanswers-20261126.csv, kv-cache-dataflow-evidence.pdf). If you need original logs, let us know and we'll coordinate a transient share link.
- Timeline: draft to you by 2026-11-27 EOD PST. If SOC-2 artifact is required from your end, a morning delivery on the 27th still works for our schedule.

Questions for clarification:
1) For the redline view do you prefer an inline "old_answer -> new_answer" column in the CSV or a separate PDF with contextual notes?
2) For Q112 (third-party cache) do you want configuration-level artifacts (configs/logs) or a high-level design + control explanation?

Rishi and Mina — I'll own coordination with Acme. Rishi can lead the mapping; Mina can handle evidence pull for the runtime questions.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0192

Attachment (planned): redwood-sig-reanswers-20261126.csv

- Flagged items: Q73 (retention scoping) and Q112 (third-party cache) look like they changed semantics and will need either a short engineering note or a config snapshot.
- ETA: draft CSV by EOD 11/26 internal; final to Acme 11/27 as Olga proposed.

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com, liam.oconnor@acmefinancials.com
Date: 2026-11-26T14:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG v4 delta & evidence request — technical notes

Thanks — quick technical clarifications for the reviewers at Acme: 

- Q73 (data retention): SIG v4 tightened the retention window wording. Our internal answer will stay the same in intent but we will provide a retention policy excerpt (retention_policy_v2.pdf) and an example S3 lifecycle rule. Evidence: kv-cache-dataflow-evidence.pdf will include trace of retention TTLs and purge job timestamps.

- Q112 (third-party cache): the semantics now call out "cache eviction guarantees". Redwood uses a KV cache layer that is managed by our runtime; the control is: cache TTLs, automated eviction, and explicit API calls to invalidate keys. Attached I will include: brief config snippet, a short diagram, and the audit extract. If Acme wants config-level artifacts, we'll need a signed NDA addendum or a secure share (we prefer ephemeral link).

Suggested short re-answers (for CSV):
- old_qid:123 -> new_qid:Q73_new: "Retention policy: data used for inference is retained for X days; automated purge runs daily; exceptions logged and auditable."
- old_qid:198 -> new_qid:Q112_new: "Cache controls: runtime-enforced TTLs, documented eviction policies; manual invalidation via admin API; no persistent sensitive state stored in cache."

I'll attach kv-cache-dataflow-evidence.pdf to the draft and include evidence_refs pointing to the Drive folder.

—Mina
Senior Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmefinancials.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: security@acmefinancials.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, mina.haddad@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-27T15:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG v4 delta & evidence request — confirmation

Thanks team — that plan works for us. A few quick confirmations:
- Consolidated CSV is preferred (old_id,new_id,old_ans,new_ans,notes,evidence_refs).
- For the redline view, an inline CSV column is fine; our auditors like a short PDF summary for the top 10 diffs.
- We'll send the SOC-2 artifact (scope + relevant controls) by 11/27 10:00 AM PST — we'll post the share to the Drive folder you provided.

Please proceed with your draft and upload to the Drive link. If you anticipate any change to the ETA, ping me asap.

Appreciate the quick turnaround,
Liam O'Connor
Senior InfoSec Manager
Acme Financials
